profile.headline: Systems and software engineer
profile.summary:
•	Complex Algorithm Development
•	Software Integration and Testing
•	Interface Management
•	Hardware and Software Requirements Definition
•	Embedded Software Development (Windows XP Embedded and 8 bit assembler)
•	TCP/IP Software Interfaces
•	Troubleshooting and Problem Solving
•	Presenting to Customers and Upper Management
•	Rapid Development of New Skills
•	Software Development (Fortran 77 and 90, C, C++ and C#)
•	Tools: DOORS, Clearcase, Clearquest, Visual Studio

Specialties: Algorithmics

positions.title: SYSTEMS/SOFTWARE ENGINEER
positions.description:
Software and systems engineering tasks for a variety of B-52 Systems, from a variety of angles. I have a Secret Security Clearance and my engineering tasks have included:
Software test for requirement verification and requisite troubleshooting.
Working with associate contractors for integration of weapons.
Software and Hardware Requirements development for internal and external customers.
Analysis of an 8 bit embedded system to correct long unsolved anomaly in Aircraft LRU.
Development of algorithms used in weapon ranging and a C# Monte Carlo Simulation to determine the error sensitivity of gravity weapons.
Development of software for an embedded system in C#, including the integration of a C based card driver into C# and successful integration with a Matrox Framegrabber.
Rehosting tools from Fortran 77 into Fortran 90 and C#

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Assumed responsibility and completed implementation of an Aircraft Hazard Documentation system based in Microsoft Access.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Basic administration of Oracle database implemented at client sites.
Developed installation software for client-site databases.
